channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Apple to Launch Doorbell, Lock and Thermostat Developed With LG
item.description: Apple's upcoming smart home devices will include a doorbell, thermostat, and other accessories developed through a partnership with LG Electronics. Bloomberg's Nick Turner explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Musk’s SpaceX in Talks to Borrow $40 Billion to Buy Nvidia Chips
item.description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX is in talks with banks and investors to raise $40 billion of debt to buy chips from Nvidia Corp., people familiar with the matter said, underscoring the insatiable demand among AI developers for more computing power.
item.dc:creator: Laura Benitez and Carmen Arroyo

item.title: Big Take: The Unexpected Billionaires of the AI Boom
item.description: Forget Silicon Valley. From furniture makers to toilet manufacturers, the AI infrastructure boom is creating billionaires in the unlikeliest places. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: BlackRock’s Magyera on Latest Future of Wealth Report
item.description: A BlackRock survey found that while 7 in 10 Americans believe they are on track for retirement, workplace savings may replace only 50% to 60% of the retirement income they expect to need. Jaime Magyera says the gap varies by age, income and access to a workplace plan, while competing expenses make it difficult for people to save more. She speaks to Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Apollo’s Zelter Says Compute, Energy Will Be AI Bottlenecks
item.description: Apollo Global Management President Jim Zelter says compute and energy will remain bottlenecks as the artificial intelligence investment boom accelerates. Speaking with Bloomberg’s Francine Lacqua, Zelter discusses Apollo’s exposure to AI and data centers, the outlook for the US economy, the growing role of private capital in defense, as well as European investment and the opportunities in the UK. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Dimensional PM on IPO Pipeline, Concentration Risks
item.description: Joel Schneider, Dimensional’s Deputy Head of Portfolio Management for North America, says well-founded IPOs can attract strong interest regardless of broader market conditions, but investors should look beyond the initial pop: IPOs have historically tended to underperform the market afterward, making fundamentals and entry timing important. He notes that index providers add new listings on different schedules, so index-fund investors effectively delegate that decision to an index committee. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: How AI Hardware Suppliers Are Becoming Billionaires: Big Take Asia
item.description: From furniture makers to toilet manufacturers, the AI infrastructure boom has minted a new, unglamorous breed of billionaire.
item.dc:creator: K Oanh Ha, Naomi Ng and Yang Yang

item.title: Nassim Taleb Calls Stocks a 'Trap,' Sees 'Naive' AI Investors
item.description: Nassim Taleb, author of “The Black Swan” and distinguished scientist at Universa Investments, calls the stock market a "trap" and sees a class of "naive" investors who will invest in firms linked to AI during an interview with Bloomberg's Natalia Kniazhevich at the Greenwich Economic Forum. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Boston Dynamics Taps Amazon Alexa Executive as New CEO
item.description: Boston Dynamics appointed former Amazon.com Inc. executive Rohit Prasad as chief executive officer to lead the Hyundai Motor Co.-controlled company into its next era of innovation and commercialization of its robots.
item.dc:creator: Samantha Murphy Kelly

item.title: Union Square Advisors President on M&A Landscape
item.description: Deal value fell 10% year over year in the third quarter after a strong first half, when global M&A was up nearly 50% and included 47 deals worth at least $10 billion. Ted Smith, President and Co-Founder of Union Square Advisors, attributed the pullback partly to typical summer seasonality and expects a busy fourth quarter; he said the $5 trillion record set in 2021 remains within reach. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Clarity Fallout, Figure's Mike Cagney, Crypto VCs
item.description: "Bloomberg Crypto" covers the people, transactions, and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance. Today's guests: Figure Executive Chairman & Co-Founder Mike Cagney, Solana Policy Institute President & Blockchain Association Incoming Interim CEO Kristin Smith, Illuminate Financial General Partner, Head of NY Alexander Ross, BlackRock US Head of Equity ETFs Jay Jacobs, and 'Crypto Is Macro Now' Author & Coindesk Former Managing Director of Research Noelle Acheson. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Zscaler CEO: AI Models Are Raising Demand for Security
item.description: Zscaler shares rose about 4% as the company reaffirmed its first-quarter and full-year guidance at investor day. CEO Jay Chaudhry said businesses see AI as a way to boost revenue and efficiency, but worry that AI agents could create cybersecurity risks, driving stronger demand for zero-trust security. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Apple’s Smart Home Push Includes Doorbell, Lock, Thermostat Codeveloped With LG
item.description: Apple Inc.’s upcoming push into smart home devices will include a doorbell, thermostat and other accessories developed through an unusual partnership with LG Electronics Inc.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman

item.title: Goldman Sachs Ensnared in EY Data Breach Earlier This Year
item.description: Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s data was exposed earlier this year in a hack of accounting firm EY, according to a person familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Katherine Chiglinsky

item.title: Open-Source AI Tools Are Problem for Stopping Child Predators
item.description: Once the models are downloaded, illegal acts are almost impossible to track.
item.dc:creator: Kurt Wagner and Jordan Robertson

item.title: Investor 'Floodgates' Opened For IBIT ETF: BlackRock's Jacobs
item.description: Jay Jacobs, US head of equity ETFs BlackRock, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the attractiveness of the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (ticker: IBIT) to investor portfolios. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bitcoin Becoming Portfolio Allocation: BlackRock's Jacobs
item.description: Jay Jacobs, US head of equity ETFs BlackRock, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the attractiveness of the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (ticker: IBIT) to investor portfolios. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: RBA Frets Potential AI Stock Slump Could Hit Australian Spending
item.description: Australian households have significant exposure to artificial-intelligence stocks, leaving consumer spending and the broader economy vulnerable to a sharp correction, according to internal Reserve Bank documents.
item.dc:creator: Michael Heath

item.title: Tracking Stablecoin Supply, Circulation
item.description: On "Bloomberg Crypto" Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat discuss the new Bloomberg function RWAS that tracks the circulation and supply of stablecoin. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Global Situation Room Issues AI Reputation Risk Warning
item.description: Isabel Guzman, chair of the Risk Advisory Council for Global Situation Room, said that misuse of AI poses reputational risks to companies as AI poses accelerated hazards around fraud and misconduct for consumers. Guzman said that while customers enjoy online advances in the financial services sector, they still want to be able to pivot to a live human to help with banking. (Source: Bloomberg)
